title: Round Table Foundation ELF research penetrating a Faraday cage

tellings.quote: frequency that can he figured out like penetrate the walls of a Faraday cage.

plain: A researcher named Andrija Puharich, working through a private research group called the Round Table Foundation from the late 1950s, is said to have found an extremely low radio frequency that could get through the walls of a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure built to block radio signals. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells this without naming a source. If it were true, a shield thought to cut off all such signals could be passed through.
